stories.summary: New campaign-finance disclosure data shows which US political campaigns are buying AI tools and how much they are spending. The findings, discussed in the book Rewiring Democracy, offer a view of how candidates, parties and committees are beginning to use AI even as politicians remain quiet about the details.

stories.title: ‘Elon is my prophet’: how Musk’s Doge team took a wrecking ball to Washington
stories.summary: A Guardian account examines how young members of Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency moved to disrupt US federal agencies. It focuses on a worker who resisted efforts involving immigrant data and traces events that followed a February 2025 email sent across the federal workforce.
